name: Exp_ColorX2MA-Parabolic
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorX2MA-Parabolic custom indicator, which combines a double-smoothed moving average (X2MA) with Parabolic SAR logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up buffer has a valid value and sell positions when the down buffer has a valid value, with configurable permissions for entries and exits. Positions are closed either on opposite signals or via fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorX2MA-Parabolic自定义指标信号进行交易，该指标结合了双重平滑移动平均线(X2MA)与Parabolic SAR逻辑。当指标的上行缓冲区有有效值时开多仓，下行缓冲区有有效值时开空仓，并可配置开仓和平仓权限。持仓通过反向信号或固定止损止盈水平平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是利用双重平滑移动平均线(X2MA)与Parabolic SAR的组合来判断趋势方向并产生交易信号。入场条件为：当ColorX2MA-Parabolic指标的第3缓冲区(UpValue)在指定信号K线上有非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生买入信号，第2缓冲区(DnValue)有非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括：反向信号触发平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓），以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数，具体逻辑封装在TradeAlgorithms.mqh中。资金管理方面，EA允许分别控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易方向控制。此外，EA还实现了历史回溯机制来寻找最近的交易方向信号以确定平仓条件，并在新K线出现时或需要重新计算时才更新信号，避免频繁交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept leverages a combination of double-smoothed moving average (X2MA) and Parabolic SAR to determine trend direction and generate trading signals. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the ColorX2MA-Parabolic indicator's buffer 3 (UpValue) has a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal is generated when buffer 2 (DnValue) has a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value. Exit conditions include: opposite signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes short, sell signal closes long), along with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation, with the actual logic encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Money management allows independent control of buy/sell open and close permissions, providing flexible trading direction control. Additionally, the EA implements a historical lookback mechanism to find the most recent directional signal for determining close conditions, and only updates signals on new bars or when recalculation is needed to avoid over-trading.

parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or lot size; negative = fixed lots

parameters.description_en: Maximum allowed price deviation in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

parameters.name: MA_Method1
parameters.description: 第一次平滑的均线方法

parameters.name: MA_Method2
parameters.description: 第二次平滑的均线方法

parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格常量
parameters.description_en: Price constant used for indicator calculation

pros: 双重平滑均线与Parabolic SAR结合，信号更稳定，减少了单一指标的假信号
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，适应不同市场环境下的策略调整需求
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少了过度交易的风险
支持按存款比例自动计算手数，便于资金管理
pros_en: Combining double-smoothed MA with Parabolic SAR produces more stable signals and reduces false signals from a single indicator
Supports 9 smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) offering high flexibility
Independent control of buy/sell open and close permissions adapts to different market conditions
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar, reducing over-trading risk
Supports deposit-share-based automatic lot sizing for convenient money management
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能在低波动品种上造成不必要的巨大风险敞口
Parabolic低点步长(0.02)和高点步长(0.2)差异10倍，参数不对称可能导致多空信号频率不一致
历史回溯查找平仓信号时遍历所有K线，在长历史数据上可能造成性能问题
缺乏点差过滤和波动率过滤，在高点差或低波动环境下可能频繁发出虚假信号
没有显式的最大持仓数量限制或关联时间过滤，存在连续信号导致过度开仓的隐患
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially creating unnecessarily large risk exposure on low-volatility instruments
Parabolic low step (0.02) differs 10x from high step (0.2), asymmetric parameters may cause inconsistent signal frequency between long and short sides
Historical lookback for close signals iterates through all bars, potentially causing performance issues with long price history
No spread filter or volatility filter, likely to generate false signals in high-spread or low-volatility environments
No explicit maximum position limit or session time filter, risking over-exposure from consecutive signals
improvements: 添加点差过滤和波动率(A TR)过滤机制，避免在不利市场条件下发出交易信号
优化历史回溯平仓信号查找逻辑，设置最大回溯K线数限制以提升性能
增加持仓数量限制和交易时段过滤，防止过度开仓
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility (ATR) filter mechanism to avoid trading signals in unfavorable market conditions
Optimize the historical lookback logic for close signal searching by setting a maximum lookback bar limit for better performance
Add maximum position count limit and trading session filter to prevent over-exposure

risk_points: 默认止损点数过大(1000点)，在低波动品种上风险敞口显著
Parabolic多空参数不对称可能导致单边信号偏好
缺乏点差过滤和最大持仓限制，存在连续亏损风险
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss is excessively large (1000 points), creating significant risk exposure on low-volatility instruments
Asymmetric Parabolic parameters for long/short may cause one-sided signal bias
Lack of spread filter and maximum position limit poses consecutive loss risk
